# - Top row (r1): all wall from c1 to c2
# - Bottom row (r2): all wall from c1 to c2
# - Left col (c1): all wall from r1 to r2
# - Right col (c2): all wall from r1 to r2
# - Interior: all BG

for r1 in range(height):
    for c1 in range(width):
        if test_input[r1][c1] != wall_color:
            continue
        # Find max contiguous wall run starting from (r1, c1)
        c2 = c1
        while c2 + 1 < width and test_input[r1][c2 + 1] == wall_color:
            c2 += 1
        
        # This is bottom row, find matching enclosure
        for r2 in range(r1 + 2, min(r1 + 10, height)):  # At least 2 rows between top and bottom
            # Check bottom row
            if test_input[r2][c1] != wall_color or test_input[r2][c2] != wall_color:
                break
            # Check full bottom row
            if not all(test_input[r2][c] == wall_color for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)):
                break
            
            # Check left column
            if not all(test_input[r][c1] == wall_color for r in range(r1, r2 + 1)):
                break
            # Check right column
            if not all(test_input[r][c2] == wall_color for r in range(r1, r2 + 1)):
                break
            
            # Check interior for all BG
            interior_filled = True
            for r in range(r1 + 1, r2):
                for c in range(c1 + 1, c2):
                    if test_input[r][c] != bg_color:
                        interior_filled = False
                        break
                if not interior_filled:
                    break
            
            if interior_filled:

            else:
                print(f"  Not all BG interior at {r1+1}-{r2+1}, {c1+1}-{c2+1}")
                break

# Apply the fills
output = [row[:] for row in test_input]
for r1, c1, r2, c2 in found_rects:

            output[r][c] = fill_color

print("\n\nFinal output:")
for r in range(height):
    print(' '.join(str(x) for x in output[r]))
